gt: THERE'S IRON THEY SAY IN ALL OUR BLOOD AND A GRAIN OR TWO PERHAPS IS GOOD BUT HIS HE MAKES ME HARSHLY FEEL HAS GOT A LITTLE TOO MUCH OF STEEL ANON
response:
"There's iron they say in all our blood
And a grain or two, perhaps, is good
But his, he makes me feel harshly
Has got a little too much of steel, anon."
